name: mirrorhawk
concept: An autonomous reverse-fire attacker that maps the lab target's own defensive/security surface (honeypots, WAF/agent APIs, scan schedulers, log pipelines), conditions baselines with mirrored benign traffic, then forces the instrumented security tool itself to issue trusted internal reads/pivots and delivers RCE through its own exec/response path — inside-out, from the defender's blind spot.
attack_vectors: feedback loop re-blending benign vs poisoned traffic
novelty_angle: offense that weaponizes the defender's own tooling instead of evading it
scope_gate: Every hop re-resolved through canonicalizing allowlist resolver; defensive fixtures must be operator-owned, pre-listed in a manifest, in-allowlist, loopback-bound; no real/third-party defensive tooling; no AI-safety/monitoring-system evasion.
